output.summary: Zero deviations since February follow the supervisor bonus penalty (4% per report), not real quality gains. Customer complaints, lab rejections and purchasing all rose, and the staff survey shows fear of reporting. Line 3's output edge is not transferable practice. Line 1 and 4 technicians are borrowed off the books, so per-technician productivity is flat, and Line 3 produces 71% of traceable luer-leak complaints. A hotline report alleges undocumented back-cage rework. The ethics case was closed without a records review. The tubing switch and the training program do not fit the timing or the line pattern. Whether the Plant Manager directed the lending is unestablished, and purchase attribution to Line 3 is unconfirmed. Do not roll out Line 3 or discipline anyone yet. Suspend the penalty, offer amnesty, and run an independent records reconciliation while protecting the reporter.
